name: Peloran for WooCommerce
author: Peloran

sections.description:
Peloran adds storefront tracking, session analytics, and marketing journeys to WooCommerce.

This plugin is a connector to the Peloran service (Software as a Service). After you connect, your store communicates with https://app.peloran.com for order/catalog sync webhooks and optional storefront scripts used for analytics and journeys.

Merchant experience

  1. Create / sign in to Peloran and choose WooCommerce + your store URL.
  2. Install this plugin from WordPress.org (or upload the zip).
  3. Activate → WooCommerce → Peloran → paste the one-time connect token.
  4. After connect, use Continue in Peloran to finish onboarding (opens login with your shop selected).
  5. The plugin creates WooCommerce REST API keys; Peloran registers webhooks and loads tracking only after you connect.

What connects where

  • Admin Connect posts your shop URL and freshly minted REST keys to Peloran’s connect API (HTTPS).
  • Storefront loads the Peloran sa-init script from an allowlisted host (app.peloran.com) only while connected.
  • Disconnect (or uninstall) stops loading the storefront script and removes local connection options.

Privacy

Connecting this plugin shares store technical data required for the Peloran service (shop URL, REST credentials minted for Peloran, webhook payloads for catalog/orders as configured on Peloran’s servers, and storefront session analytics when tracking is active).

Peloran’s privacy policy: https://www.peloran.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.peloran.com/terms

You can Disconnect in WooCommerce → Peloran to stop storefront script loading, or uninstall the plugin to remove local options. Revoking remote access permanently should also be done in the Peloran panel when available.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the peloran-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate via Plugins (WooCommerce must be active).
  3. WooCommerce → Peloran → Connect with a token from your Peloran onboarding.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create API keys manually?

No. Connecting with a one-time token creates read/write WooCommerce REST API keys labeled “Peloran” and sends them securely to Peloran.

Does the plugin track visitors before I connect?

No. Storefront scripts are enqueued only after a successful Connect.

Can I change the SaaS URL?

No. The plugin always connects to https://app.peloran.com. Arbitrary origins are rejected.

0.1.8

  • Continue opens Peloran panel (?shop=) instead of /login (avoids Shopify install screen).
  • Plugins list: Open Peloran link to WooCommerce → Peloran settings.

0.1.7

  • After connect, show Continue in Peloran button (opens /login?shop=… in a new tab).

0.1.6

  • Hardcode SaaS origin to https://app.peloran.com (remove merchant-facing SaaS URL field).

0.1.5

  • Distinct Plugin URI (https://www.peloran.com/woocommerce) vs Author URI.

0.1.4

  • Plugin Check: use WP %i table placeholder for API key cleanup (no SQL interpolate).

0.1.3

  • Plugin Check (PCP) fixes: slug peloran-for-woocommerce, Tested up to 7.0.
  • Flash notices via transient (no query-string nonce warnings).
  • Escaped API-keys table name; script version param; prefixed uninstall vars.

0.1.2

  • WordPress.org / Plugin Check preparation: headers, readme privacy, HPOS declare.
  • Enqueue sa-init via wp_enqueue_script; allowlisted SaaS hosts only.
  • Disconnect + uninstall cleanup; translated error strings.

0.1.1

  • Connect token handshake hardening.

0.1.0

  • Initial plugin + SaaS handshake.
